environment.tool: manual audit of the final tag source + live compiled binary; raw-socket client sending exact bytes, strict-token upstream peer logging verbatim request bytes and byte count

findings.description: The forward loop unions a fixed hop list with the client's Connection tokens, then re-emits only surviving headers with no Content-Length re-add and no body streaming. range, if-none-match, accept-encoding and authorization are all deleted on the client's word, changing the upstream's answer (304 becomes 200, 206 becomes 200). POST is refused at the method gate, so the unframed-body shape cannot fire.
findings.title: The client-nominated deletion set removes every probed non-framing header from the forwarded request

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
methods: Control request first on the same config
Raw client bytes and raw upstream bytes captured in hex
Payload diffed against the control line

author_attested: analysis metadata reconstructed after the run
verified: release tag resolves to the submitted source
source SHA-256 and report and evidence hashes

scope: Final tag of run 29d05850; proxy location; client-controlled header deletion
